notes: Large cardamom from Ilam, Taplejung, Dhankuta. Nepal supplies ~60% of global large cardamom. Harvest: Sept-Oct; auctions in Kolkata & EU.
Ginger from Ilan, Jhapa, Dhankuta. Nepal is 2nd largest ginger exporter globally. Harvest: Sept-Oct; peak export Oct-Nov.
Black pepper from Jhapa, Ilam, Kaski. Small-scale; primarily to India & SE Asia.
Orthodox tea from Ilam, Dhankuta, Jhapa. CTLSH certified; premium Darjeeling-style production. Harvest: Mar-Oct; peak flush Apr-May & Sept-Oct.
Arabica coffee from Gulmi, Palpa, Arghakhanchi, Syangja. NCA Organic & Fair Trade certified. Harvest: Oct-May; export season Nov-June.
Sugarcane from Terai districts (Bara, Parsa, Rautahat, Dhanusha). Raw sugar & ethanol feedstock. Harvest: Oct-Apr; export as raw sugar & molasses.
